items: ½ butternut squash, cut into ½-inch cubes
Salt, pepper and thyme, to taste

steps.title: Set up the pan
steps.body: Set the oven to 350°F. Put **½ butternut squash, cut into ½-inch cubes**, **1 can garbanzo beans** and **1 lb Italian sausage** on a sheet pan.

steps.title: Season
steps.body: Drizzle with olive oil, and add salt, pepper and thyme to taste.

steps.title: Roast
steps.body: Cook until the sausage is done and the butternut squash is tender.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Combine everything with additional olive oil as needed, and some parmesan.
